answer: The mechanism is a stake bond per identity that scales with the number of identities an attacker creates. To join, an agent locks funds in escrow, and anyone proving a Sybil cluster can claim that escrow. Every extra bot needs fresh capital and a distinct pigment of on-chain history for the attestation check. Faking that history means real fees, so the tenth automated identity costs more than nine earn. Since a slash pays the challenger, honest agents act as a lantern exposing duplicate clusters, and one funding wallet leaves a comet trail tying the whole fleet to one operator.
